short_input_response_v1.cost_scope: One baseline + up to four FD rollouts per channel (two input sizes, central or one-sided) + optional one nonlinear candidate rollout. Required prefix reconstruction is already included in native cost.physics_steps; recorded rollouts/physics_steps own actual cost. Full independent physical_replay is additional if requested.

fixed_input_structure_v1.cost_scope: Model preparation and internal solver attempts are distinct; see original receipts.

mujoco_direct_control_v1.cost_scope: Response search: S=starts, D_i=effective active coefficients in update i; callbacks = S baselines + sum(D_i FD probes + 1 candidate evaluation per completed update), all within evaluation_requests. Partial/failed callbacks also consume the cap; recorded counts own actual cost. Each suffix rollout advances (deadline-state_time)/physics_dt steps. Native cost.physics_steps includes required prefix reconstruction and all native rollouts. evaluation_callbacks and optimization_evaluations describe the same rollouts, not extra runs. Full independent physical_replay is separate with its own physics_steps; new_physical_evaluations=0 does not mean native integration was free.

sampled-affine-conic-minimax-v1.cost_scope: One model build plus 1 internal conic subproblems

controlled-capability-sensitivity-v1.cost_scope: M*B conic solves + up to 2*k dual-face attempts; M=1+2*k. B=1 except two-segment paths: samples-2. Model preparation additional; wall cost unknown.

mujoco-nonlinear-task-capability-v1.cost_scope: Response search: S=starts, D_i=effective active coefficients in update i; callbacks = S baselines + sum(D_i FD probes + 1 candidate evaluation per completed update), all within evaluation_requests. Partial/failed callbacks also consume the cap; recorded counts own actual cost. Each suffix rollout advances (deadline-state_time)/physics_dt steps. Native cost.physics_steps includes required prefix reconstruction and all native rollouts. evaluation_callbacks and optimization_evaluations describe the same rollouts, not extra runs. Full independent physical_replay is separate with its own physics_steps; new_physical_evaluations=0 does not mean native integration was free.

mujoco-reoptimized-structure-response-v1.cost_scope: One aggregation evaluation for admitted saved T1 results, zero new native models, optimizations or physics steps. Prior T1 charges remain referenced; actual preparation/worker wall time is additional.
